title: ‘Can we accept what we have done or not done?’: harrowing film follows doctors in Gaza

paragraphs.en: When she wanted to confront Americans about the consequences of their actions – or inactions – in Gaza, Poh Si Teng reached for a genre with mass popular appeal: the medical drama.
paragraphs.zh: 当滕珀茜想直面美国人在加沙的行为——或不作为——所带来的后果时，她选择了一种具有大众吸引力的类型：医疗剧。

paragraphs.en: “Whether it’s The Pitt, Grey’s Anatomy, House, ER, even a comedy like Scrubs, you name it,” the documentary film-maker says via Zoom from her New York apartment. “I thought to myself, there’s something about medical dramas and doctors and human mortality in this space so let’s make The Pitt . The difference is it’s real and it’s set in Gaza and maybe this is the way to bring Palestine back to the United States.”
paragraphs.zh: “不管是《匹兹堡急诊室》、《实习医生格蕾》、《豪斯医生》、《急诊室的故事》，还是像《实习医生风云》这样的喜剧，随便你说，”这位纪录片电影人从她纽约的公寓通过 Zoom 说，“我心想，医疗剧、医生和人类死亡在这个领域自有一种力量，所以让我们做一部《匹兹堡急诊室》。不同的是，它是真实的，背景设在加沙，也许这就是把巴勒斯坦带回美国的方法。”

paragraphs.en: Related: ‘She wasn’t acting, she wanted to live it’: how a fake pregnancy resulted in the wildest true crime film of the year
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：“她没有在演戏，她是想亲身体验它”：一场假怀孕如何催生了今年最疯狂的犯罪纪实电影

paragraphs.en: The result is American Doctor , a 93-minute film directed by Teng and co-produced with Kirstine Barfod and Reem Haddad, which premiered at the Sundance film festival and is out now in US cinemas.
paragraphs.zh: 成果就是《美国医生》这部 93 分钟的电影，由滕珀茜执导，与克里斯汀·巴福和里姆·哈达德联合制片。影片在圣丹斯电影节首映，目前正在美国影院上映。

paragraphs.en: The documentary follows three doctors from different cultural and religious backgrounds – Thaer Ahmad , a Palestinian-American emergency doctor; Mark Perlmutter , a Jewish orthopedic surgeon from North Carolina; and Feroze Sidhwa , a Zoroastrian trauma surgeon based in California – as they volunteer on the frontlines of Gaza’s collapsing hospital system.
paragraphs.zh: 这部纪录片跟随三位来自不同文化和宗教背景的医生——巴勒斯坦裔美国急诊医生赛尔·艾哈迈德、来自北卡罗来纳州的犹太骨科外科医生马克·珀尔马特，以及常驻加利福尼亚州的琐罗亚斯德教创伤外科医生费罗泽·西德瓦——看他们在加沙不断崩溃的医疗系统前线志愿服务。

paragraphs.en: They return to the US as advocates in the halls of Congress, which continues to send military aid to Israel. The film highlights the unique position of American doctors as witnesses whose professional standing makes their testimony difficult for politicians and even rightwing media to dismiss as propaganda.
paragraphs.zh: 他们回到美国，在继续向以色列提供军事援助的国会大厅里奔走呼吁。影片凸显了美国医生的独特地位：作为目击者，他们的职业身份使政客乃至右翼媒体都难以将其证词斥为宣传。

paragraphs.en: The journey of Teng to making the film began in the fall of 2024, a year into the military campaign in Gaza . The Malaysian-American had spent years as a producer, documentary commissioning editor for Al Jazeera English and creative director at ABC/Disney but felt suffocated by the professional and political silence surrounding what she does not hesitate to call a genocide.
paragraphs.zh: 滕珀茜制作这部影片的旅程始于 2024 年秋天，当时加沙的军事行动已进行了一年。这位马来西亚裔美国人曾多年担任制片人、半岛电视台英语频道纪录片监制和 ABC/迪士尼的创意总监，但她感到被围绕这场她毫不讳言称之为种族灭绝的事件的职业与政治沉默所窒息。

paragraphs.en: “I was so frustrated and it felt like nothing was changing,” the 41-year-old explains. “In our journalism circles, even though we were seeing so many Gazan journalists being targeted and executed, it felt like in the western part of the world – specifically where I was situated in New York – that people were still whispering about Palestine and what was going on in Gaza. That’s when I decided I need to quit my job if I’m going to do this, and I’m going to make a film.”
paragraphs.zh: “我无比沮丧，感觉什么都没有改变，”这位 41 岁的导演解释说，“在我们的新闻圈里，尽管我们看到那么多加沙记者遭到针对和处决，但在西方世界——尤其是当我身处纽约时——人们似乎仍在小声谈论巴勒斯坦和加沙正在发生的事。就在那时我决定，如果我要做这件事，我就必须辞职，然后我要拍一部电影。”
